# Draft:MV Viking Orion

Viking Orion is a Sea-class cruise ship operated by Viking Ocean Cruises, it is a sister ship to MV Viking Sky and is 748 ft and 47,842 GRT (Gross Register Tons) she can accommodate 930 passengers in 465 cabins.
Capacity & Accommodation
* Passenger Capacity: 930 guests
* Crew Size: 550
* Total Decks: 14 (10 accessible to passengers)
* Staterooms: 465 total staterooms, all featuring private verandas
